_comment: Acceptance contract for brain/10-specs/s16c-memory-by-construction.md. The agent may ONLY flip 'passes'. Entries may never be added, removed, or reworded. Written 2026-09-20 (unattended run 7).

features.description: A memory tool bound for an unattended run returns the fixed not-kept result and writes no row, with the unattended flag explicitly False.
The same tool returns the same result whatever the flag says: unset, False, True.
The unattended tool never reaches the write path at all: with save_memory replaced by something that raises, it still returns the not-kept result.
Control: a tool bound the attended way does reach the write path, so the assertion above cannot pass vacuously.
After a non-streaming run returns, frappe.flags.flow_unattended is False and flow_run is None.
After a non-streaming run raises, frappe.flags.flow_unattended is False and flow_run is None.
The binding is not the only defence: a caller that built the tool the attended way inside an unattended run still writes nothing, because the flag refusal in save_memory remains.
A streamed run with a kept note present delivers the memory block exactly once, in the last user message, and completes.
The transcript stored by a streamed run with a note present contains no memory block and no message twice.
A run that exhausts its iteration budget writes no note and leaves no question a person can no longer answer.
A pending memory approval is never consumed by the iteration budget: the pausing turn returns Paused rather than exhausting it.
The file-injection budget is reduced by exactly the length of the memory block delivered this turn.
For a turn with no notes the budget is the number it was before this change, computed on the same session.
_invoke, _resolve_confirmation, _confirmation_question and _has_denial are unchanged, and upstream's TestAgentConfirmation is unmodified and green.
No text this change puts in front of the model or a person names the platform, a vendor or a model.
